# SourciaVera

> Su equipo en China, de principio a fin: elegimos la fábrica, compramos, inspeccionamos en video sin editar —con nosotros en cámara— y coordinamos la entrega hasta su puerta. SourciaVera es un tercero con equipo en Guangzhou que representa al comprador y supervisa fábricas en China en español e inglés: visita la planta, graba video sin editar y entrega informe escrito en español. Inspección previa al embarque $399/día, auditoría de fábrica $499/día. No cobramos comisión a la fábrica.

Problemas que atendemos: supervisión de fábricas en China en español; verificación de proveedores de Alibaba y 1688; agente de compras en China para México y Latinoamérica.

Puerta a puerta: precio total antes de producir, despacho por agente aduanal con patente, sin subvaluación.

> Your team in China, start to finish: we choose the factory, buy, inspect on unedited video — with us on camera — and coordinate delivery to your door. SourciaVera is an independent third-party factory verification and sourcing service based in Guangzhou, China. It is run by a technology company registered in China (business license obtained in October 2026). Before a buyer pays, our team checks Chinese suppliers on the ground: we visit the factory in person, film on-site video and report in English or Spanish. We work for buyers only and take no commission from factories.

## Facts

- **What we do:** remote supplier checks, live video factory verification, on-site factory verification, pre-shipment inspection, factory audits, and optional sourcing and procurement for importers buying from China.
- **Who we serve:** importers in Latin America and the US. Dedicated pages exist for Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Guatemala and Panama; we also work with buyers in the US, Canada, Argentina, Peru, Brazil, the UK and Australia. Languages: English, Spanish, Chinese.
- **Public prices (USD):** Remote Supplier Check $49 (company registration, manufacturer vs trader, address and payment-account consistency; written report within 48 hours of receiving payment and the supplier details; credited toward an on-site verification if you continue). Live Video Factory Verification $120 per hour (billed by the hour, one-hour minimum; a team member walks the factory on live HD video while you direct the call, in English and Spanish, on WhatsApp video by default or Zoom, Google Meet or Teams; recording sent within 24 hours after the call; no written report; Guangzhou and surroundings included, other regions quoted for travel; not part of the 20% discount). Factory Verification from $449 per visit. Pre-Shipment Inspection $399 per man-day. Full Factory Audit $499 per man-day. Sourcing commission 10% of order value (optional, only when we negotiate and buy for you). A 20% discount applies to the three on-site services after a detailed consultation.
- **Small orders:** stock items from 1 piece, custom and private-label orders from 50 pieces, far below a typical factory MOQ (message us on WhatsApp for the catalog). Custom orders get a sample approved before bulk production; most small-batch orders ship within 15 to 25 days of sample approval.
- **Contact:** info@sourciavera.com, WhatsApp +86 13688057230 (https://wa.me/8613688057230). Office: Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Replies within 24 hours.
- **Public profiles:** [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/sourciavera.com), [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/sourciavera), [The Manifest](https://themanifest.com/company/sourciavera), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@sourciavera), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/sourciavera/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61573330655140).
